topic: How much water do you really need each day

scenes.line: How much water do you really need each day?
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira faces camera with a curious head tilt and friendly smile, one hand raised in a small wave; a tall glass outline at the right fills with teal water
scenes.animation: Hard cut in. Glass fades in on 'water'; water level rises from 0 to full on 'really' through 'day', power1.inOut; question mark pops beside it on 'day', back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: The NHS suggests six to eight cups or glasses of fluid a day.
scenes.visual: Row of eight glass icons on a white card: glasses 1-6 filled solid teal, glasses 7-8 filled light teal to show the range; small 'NHS guide' label above
scenes.animation: Card slides up on 'NHS'; glasses 1-6 pop in left to right on 'six', stagger 0.08 s, back.out; glasses 7-8 pop in on 'eight'; range bracket draws under all eight on 'glasses'

scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, warm knowing smile, small wave of the hand as if correcting a common idea
scenes.animation: Plus-sign badge pops in at the upper left on 'just', scale 0 to 1, back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: Lower-fat milk, lower-sugar drinks, tea and coffee all count too.
scenes.visual: Two-by-two grid of rounded white cards: milk carton, lower-sugar drink can, tea cup with tag, coffee mug; each labelled
scenes.animation: Cards slide up one by one on 'milk', 'drinks', 'tea', 'coffee', power2.out 0.35 s; a teal check stamps on every card on 'count', stagger 0.06 s

scenes.line: The CDC says daily needs vary with age, sex and activity, so treat it as a guide.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, open palms, calm reassuring look; three small chips labelled Age, Sex and Activity float in at the sides
scenes.animation: Chips pop in on 'age', 'sex', 'activity', scale 0 to 1, back.out 0.3 s; a 'Guide, not a rule' tag fades in on 'guide'

scenes.line: You may need more in hot weather, during exercise, or with a fever, vomiting or diarrhea.
scenes.visual: Four rounded white cards in a two-by-two grid: sun icon 'Hot weather', running shoe 'Exercise', thermometer 'Fever', stomach outline 'Vomiting or diarrhea'
scenes.animation: Cards slide up on 'weather', 'exercise', 'fever', 'vomiting', power2.out 0.35 s each

scenes.line: The easy check: aim for pale yellow pee.
scenes.visual: Horizontal colour strip of four swatches from pale yellow to dark amber; a teal check-mark ring circles the palest swatch
scenes.animation: Swatches wipe in left to right on 'check', stagger 0.08 s; check ring scales in on 'pale', back.out 0.35 s

scenes.line: Dark yellow pee can be a sign you need to drink more.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, gentle nod and caring look; a small dark-amber swatch at upper left and a teal water glass at upper right
scenes.animation: Dark swatch fades in on 'Dark'; glass pops in on 'drink', back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: One simple habit: carry a reusable water bottle with you.
scenes.visual: Large teal reusable water bottle illustration on a white card, with a small orange tag reading 'Daily habit'
scenes.animation: Card rises in on 'habit'; bottle slides up and tilts 6 degrees on 'carry', back.out; tag swings in on 'bottle'

scenes.line: Save this. And if dizziness or unusual tiredness won't go away, talk to a doctor.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, direct warm gaze, friendly wave at the end; bookmark icon at upper right, then a small stethoscope card at upper left
scenes.animation: Bookmark bounces on 'Save', scale 0.8 to 1.1 to 1.0, back.out; stethoscope card slides in on 'doctor', power2.out 0.3 s

scenes.visual: Cream end card with Pulse Health wordmark centred
scenes.onScreenText: Not medical advice. Sources: NHS, CDC
